title: Invoker
text:
Invoker is an Ascendancy class for the Monk.


== Overview ==
The Invoker is attuned to nature, providing mastery over the elements. He can empower his elemental attacks with critical hits that ignore resistances and trigger Elemental Expression to wipe out enemies, or unleash Unbound Avatar to gain a massive boost to his elemental offense after applying elemental ailments enough times. The Invoker has access to Meta skill synergies, with Lead me through Grace... to gain Spirit from his body armour defences and The Soul Springs Eternal to trigger them faster and have more efficient reservations. The Invoker can also has the ability to gain physical damage reduction from his Evasion rating and Meditate to overcharge his energy shield.
